subject: Add ARM SVE support
perf_evidence: Adds ARM SVE vector division by fixed constants and SVE benchmarks; SIMD path has clear throughput intent.
change_summary: Introduces new SVE vector division APIs and implementation, absent in the parent commit.
notes: This is an API addition, so old/new equivalence of the new entry points is undefined; Alive2 also does not support the SVE scalable-vector IR.

units.name: new SVE vector division API
units.evidence: The old revision has no SVE API; the attempted shared harness fails to compile on the old side.
